description: Top 40 identities by signal volume, one tile per identity, in a block per kind. Area grows with the square root of event volume and every tile gets a minimum share so its name stays readable; colour is accumulated severity. Grouped on raw fields first and resolved afterwards, so an identity whose events disagree about its kind is still one tile, in its most specific block.

url.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE (attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("cluster:monitor/main", "elastic.maintenance") OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/search*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/*point_in_time" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:data/read/open_reader_context")) AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("authentication_success","connection_granted"))) | EVAL risk = CASE(attributes.event.action == "invalidate_apikeys", 45, attributes.event.action == "anonymous_access_denied", 35, attributes.elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL, 50, attributes.event.outcome == "failure", 40, (resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((attributes.event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR attributes.event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))) AND attributes.event.action IN ("workflow_run","workflow_test","workflow_execution_cancel"), 10, (resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((attributes.event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR attributes.event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))) AND (attributes.event.type == "deletion" OR attributes.event.action == "rule_disable"), 30, (resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((attributes.event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR attributes.event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))), 25, 0) | STATS events = COUNT(*), severity = SUM(risk), scoring = COUNT(CASE(risk > 0, 1, null)) BY attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.email, attributes.user.name, attributes.user.domain | EVAL actor = CASE(attributes.api_key.name IS NOT NULL, attributes.api_key.name, COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>")), kind_rank = CASE(attributes.api_key.name IS NOT NULL, 4, attributes.user.email IS NOT NULL, 3, attributes.user.domain == "_cloud_api_key", 2, 1), owner = CASE(attributes.api_key.name IS NOT NULL, COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.user.name), null) | STATS events = SUM(events), severity = SUM(severity), scoring = SUM(scoring), kind_rank = MAX(kind_rank), owner = MAX(owner) BY actor | EVAL actor_kind = CASE(kind_rank == 4, "named API key", kind_rank == 3, "person", kind_rank == 2, "cloud API key", "unattributed") | SORT events DESC | LIMIT 40 | KEEP actor, actor_kind, owner, events, severity, scoring

max(1, floor((datum.tw - 8) / (datum.fs * 0.6)))
floor((datum.th - 4) / datum.lh)
